_note: Machine-readable instrument dispositions — the executable form of the reproduction rule (CLAUDE.md; Option A, 2026-08-23). Seeded from the decision table in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-20-instrument-reproduction-audit.md. Enforced hard at build time by check-static-site.mjs §11 via instrument-rights-gate.mjs. Discipline: a status here is a governance decision — change it only with the decisionRef that recorded the change, never by agent inference. Signatures detect the reproduction that shipped, never plain bedside language ('thoughts of killing yourself' is legitimate clinical phrasing in mse.html and the SP pack and must never become a signature); scan scope is learner-rendered HTML only (matcher vocabulary in *.pack.json is not reproduction); waivers and provisional standings are file-scoped. This file is a build input and must never itself be shipped to either site. officialSource (added 2026-09-03) records where the learner gets the real instrument, so that a withdrawal leaves a route and not a dead end; the schema requires one on every retired/restricted entry, and pages pinned requireOfficialSourceLink must ship it. This library LINKS and never mirrors — hosting a whole form is broader redistribution than the excerpts that were withdrawn, so formUrl is constrained to an absolute https custodian URL and a repo-relative path is a rights change, not an edit. A recorded route is a wayfinding fact, never a permission finding: routes are refreshed freely, statuses only with a decisionRef.
